subject: Constant entry
notes: kb/Work PB1231 (w1007c). cite.py --check 13.10.3 "Neither the value of literal-1 nor the value of any of the literals in arithmetic-expression-1 shall be dependent, directly or indirectly" -> OK SR5. A constant entry being evaluated is on the demand chain (DataBinder._constantsInProgress); a reference that re-enters it closes the cycle, reported once at the re-entered entry with the chain named: `01 J CONSTANT AS J + 1.` -> 'circular dependence (J -> J) ... (ISO 13.10.3 SR5)' (negative pb1231-constant-direct-cycle), `01 K CONSTANT AS K2 + 1. 01 K2 CONSTANT AS K * 2.` -> '(K -> K2 -> K)' (pb1231-constant-indirect-cycle), each at 2002/2014/2023, with no cascade (the operand recovers as 1). The legal forward reference compiles: `01 KB CONSTANT AS K2 + 1. 01 K2 CONSTANT AS 3.` -> KB = 4 (golden pb1231_constant_forward_references).
